items.informal_name: Taylor Expansion Formula for Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) f = f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f $ in $ R[X] $ and any element $ r $ in the semiring $ R $, the Taylor expansion of $ f $ at $ r $ is equal to the composition of $ f $ with the polynomial $ X + r $, i.e., $ \text{Tay}_r(f) = f(X + r) $, where $ X $ denotes the indeterminate of the polynomial ring.

items.informal_name: Taylor Expansion Evaluation Identity: $(\mathrm{taylor}\, r\, f)(s) = f(s + r)$
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (s : R),
  Polynomial.eval s ((Polynomial.taylor r) f) = Polynomial.eval (s + r) f
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f \in R[X] $ and elements $ r, s \in R $, the evaluation of the Taylor expansion of $ f $ at $ r $ at $ s $ equals $ f(s + r) $.

items.informal_name: Taylor Expansion of X at r: $\operatorname{taylor}_r(X) = X + r$
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R), (Polynomial.taylor r) Polynomial.X = Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r
items.informal_description: For any element $ r $ in a semiring $ R $, applying the Taylor expansion at $ r $ to the indeterminate $ X $ results in the polynomial $ X + r $, i.e., $\operatorname{taylor}_r(X) = X + r$.

items.informal_name: The Taylor Shift Operator: Algebra Homomorphism vs. Linear Map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R) (a : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.taylorAlgHom r) a = (Polynomial.taylor r) a
items.informal_description:
Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, $r \in R$, and $p$ a polynomial over $R$. Then
$$ (\text{Polynomial.taylorAlgHom } r)(p) = (\text{Polynomial.taylor } r)(p) $$
Here, `Polynomial.taylorAlgHom r` and `Polynomial.taylor r` are the Taylor shift operator $p(X) \mapsto p(X+r)$, viewed as an $R$-algebra homomorphism and an $R$-linear map, respectively.

items.informal_name: Action of the Polynomial Shift Automorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] (t : R) (a : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC t) a = (Polynomial.aeval (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t)) a
items.informal_description: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $t \in R$. For any polynomial $p \in R[X]$, the action of the algebra automorphism `Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC t` on $p$ is given by the evaluation of $p$ at the polynomial $X+t$. This corresponds to substituting the variable $X$ with $X+t$ in the polynomial $p$.

items.informal_name: Taylor Expansion Evaluation Identity: $\text{Tay}_r(f)(s - r) = f(s)$
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (s : R),
  Polynomial.eval (s - r) ((Polynomial.taylor r) f) = Polynomial.eval s f
items.informal_description: For any semiring $R$, element $r \in R$, and polynomial $f \in R[X]$, evaluating the Taylor expansion of $f$ at $r$ (denoted $\text{Tay}_r(f)$) at the point $s - r$ yields $f(s)$. Symbolically, $\text{Tay}_r(f)(s - r) = f(s)$.

items.informal_name: Taylor series expansion at r
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → R → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R
items.informal_description: For a given element $ r $ in a semiring $ R $, the Taylor series expansion at $ r $ is the $ R $-linear map from $ R[X] $ to $ R[X] $ that sends each polynomial $ f $ to the composition $ f(X + r) $.

items.informal_name: Composition of Taylor Expansions: $ T_r(T_s(f)) = T_{r+s}(f) $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (r s : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) ((Polynomial.taylor s) f) = (Polynomial.taylor (r + s)) f
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f \in R[X] $ and elements $ r, s \in R $, composing the Taylor series expansion at $ r $ with the Taylor series expansion at $ s $ yields the same result as the Taylor series expansion at $ r + s $. Formally, $ \operatorname{taylor}_r(\operatorname{taylor}_s f) = \operatorname{taylor}_{r+s} f $. This expresses the additive property of Taylor shifts in polynomial rings over semirings.

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_X
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (f : σ → S₁) (s : σ) : (MvPolynomial.aeval f) (MvPolynomial.X s) = f s

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] : MvPolynomial.aeval MvPolynomial.X = AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_unique
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] [Algebra R S₁] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] S₁) : φ = MvPolynomial.aeval (⇑φ ∘ MvPolynomial.X)

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (MvPolynomial.aeval MvPolynomial.X) p = p

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_sumElim
items.type: {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_2} {T : Type u_3} [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] [CommSemiring T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] {σ : Type u_4} {τ : Type u_5} (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) (f : τ → S) (g : σ → T) : (MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim g (⇑(algebraMap S T) ∘ f))) p = (MvPolynomial.aeval g) ((MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X (⇑MvPolynomial.C ∘ f))) p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename_eq
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) : MvPolynomial.rename f = MvPolynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X ∘ f)

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename_eq_aeval
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_4} [CommSemiring R] (f : σ → τ) : MvPolynomial.rename f = MvPolynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X ∘ f)

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight_apply
items.type: (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R) : (MvPolynomial.optionEquivRight R S₁) a = (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X) MvPolynomial.X) a

items.name: MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_apply
items.type: (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (a : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R) : (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) a = (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim Polynomial.X fun s => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X s)) a

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_ite_mem_eq_self
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (q : MvPolynomial σ R) {s : Set σ} (hs : ↑q.vars ⊆ s) [(i : σ) → Decidable (i ∈ s)] : (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => if i ∈ s then MvPolynomial.X i else 0) q = q

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_ite_mem_eq
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (q : MvPolynomial σ R) (s : Set σ) [DecidablePred fun x => x ∈ s] [DecidablePred fun x => ↑x.support ⊆ s] : (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => if i ∈ s then MvPolynomial.X i else 0) q = ∑ x ∈ q.support, if ↑x.support ⊆ s then (MvPolynomial.monomial x) (q.coeff x) else 0

items.name: Algebra.Generators.Hom.equivAlgHom_symm_apply_val
items.type: {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {P : Algebra.Generators R S ι} {R' : Type u_1} {S' : Type u_2} {ι' : Type u_3} [CommRing R'] [CommRing S'] [Algebra R' S'] {P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι'} [Algebra R R'] [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S'] [IsScalarTower R S S'] (f : { f // ∀ (x : P.Ring), (MvPolynomial.aeval P'.val) (f x) = (algebraMap S S') ((MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) x) }) (i : ι) : (Algebra.Generators.Hom.equivAlgHom.symm f).val i = ↑f (MvPolynomial.X i)

items.informal_name: Equality of Algebra Evaluation and Two-Argument Evaluation for Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (f : σ → S₁) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), (MvPolynomial.aeval f) p = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap R S₁) f) p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, the algebra evaluation homomorphism $ \mathrm{aeval}_f(p) $ using an $ R $-algebra structure on $ S_1 $ and variable assignment $ f : \sigma \to S_1 $ is equal to the two-argument evaluation homomorphism $ \mathrm{eval}_2^{\mathrm{Hom}}(\mathrm{algebraMap}, f)(p) $, where $ \mathrm{algebraMap} : R \to S_1 $ provides the scalar evaluation. Both methods compute the same result by applying the algebra map to coefficients and substituting variables via $ f $.

items.informal_description: The algebra evaluation homomorphism for multivariate polynomials is defined by evaluating each polynomial using the canonical algebra map from $ R $ to $ S_1 $ for coefficients and a given variable assignment $ f : \sigma \to S_1 $, such that $ \text{aeval}\, f\, p = \text{eval}_2(\text{algebraMap}(R, S_1), f, p) $.

  (MvPolynomial.mapAlgHom f) p = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (MvPolynomial.C.comp ↑f) MvPolynomial.X p
items.informal_description: For commutative semirings $R$, $S_1$, $S_2$, a type $\sigma$, and an $R$-algebra homomorphism $f : S_1 \to S_2$, applying the algebra homomorphism $\mathrm{MvPolynomial.mapAlgHom}(f)$ to a polynomial $p \in \mathrm{MvPolynomial}(\sigma, S_1)$ yields the same result as evaluating $p$ using the coefficient map $\mathrm{MvPolynomial.C} \circ f$ and the variable map $\mathrm{MvPolynomial.X}$.

items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, commutative semiring $ S_1 $ with an $ R $-algebra structure, and commutative semiring $ B $, given a variable assignment $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $, a ring homomorphism $ \varphi : S_1 \to B $, and a polynomial $ p \in R[\sigma] $, applying $ \varphi $ to the algebra evaluation $ \mathrm{aeval}_g(p) $ equals evaluating $ p $ using the composed ring homomorphism $ \varphi \circ \mathrm{algebraMap}_{R \to S_1} $ on coefficients and $ \varphi \circ g $ on variables. Symbolically, $ \varphi(\mathrm{aeval}_g(p)) = \mathrm{eval}_2^{\varphi \circ \mathrm{algebraMap}, \varphi \circ g}(p) $.

Symbolically, $ \text{eval}_{\text{algebraMap}(A,B) \circ x}(p) = \text{algebraMap}(A,B)(\text{eval}_x(p)) $.
